👋 Welcome!

This is the documentation site for the Ambiorix R web framework — an
unopinionated, minimalist framework inspired by express.js.

If you have never used Ambiorix before, start with
[Get Started](/docs/getting-started) and work forward from there; each page
links to the next.

## Where things are

**Core** covers the request-response cycle: [routing](/docs/ambiorix/routing),
[parameters](/docs/ambiorix/params), the
[request](/docs/ambiorix/request) and [response](/docs/ambiorix/response)
objects, [middleware](/docs/ambiorix/middleware) and
[error handling](/docs/ambiorix/errors).

**Building** covers everything you put on top:
[rendering](/docs/ambiorix/rendering) and
[templates](/docs/ambiorix/templates),
[static files](/docs/ambiorix/static),
[websockets](/docs/ambiorix/websocket),
[async handlers](/docs/ambiorix/async) and
[logging](/docs/ambiorix/logger).

**Deploy** covers getting an app onto a server, including
[Belgic](/docs/belgic), the reverse proxy and load balancer.

**Middlewares** documents the eleven middleware packages published
alongside the framework, and **Tooling** covers the
[project generator](/docs/generator) and the
[command line interface](/docs/cli).

Longer, book-length treatment lives at
[book.ambiorix.dev](https://book.ambiorix.dev/).
